### 🐛 Describe the bug

```py
import torch
x = torch.rand((16, 64, 256), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device='cuda')
f = torch.fft.rfft(x)  # RuntimeError: Unsupported dtype BFloat16
```

In my use-case this fft operation is on very long sequences, so it would save a lot of memory!

Using FP16 leads to instability issues, so I would prefer using BF16 instead.

Are there any plans to support this? [It looks like cuFFT supports BF16 already...](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cufft/index.html#bfloat16-precision-cufft-transforms)
